subject: Mythology
title: Susanoo: The Storm God
description: A quick, practical guide to Susanoo: The Storm God.

hook.text: Susanoo was banished from heaven for his violent tantrums, but he became a hero by slaying a monstrous serpent.

buildup.text: Exiled to earth, he found an old couple weeping. An eight-headed serpent demanded their last daughter as a sacrifice.

discovery.text: Susanoo set a trap: he placed eight vats of sake out. The serpent drank from all eight and passed out.

twist.text: He found a legendary sword inside the serpent's tail — the Kusanagi, one of Japan's three sacred treasures.

climax.text: He married the girl he saved and gave the sword to Amaterasu as an apology for his past behavior.

punchline.text: The worst god in heaven became the greatest hero on earth.

quiz.question: What treasure did Susanoo find inside the eight-headed serpent?
options: The Kusanagi sword, one of Japan's three sacred treasures
A scroll containing the secrets of the gods
